title: Tiers+
description: This mod expands the game by introducing additional tiers, offering new levels of progression, challenges, and rewards for players to unlock.
body:
This mod adds an brand new tier packed with fresh challenges, and a whole new level of fun. More tiers are coming soon, so jump in now and be among the first to experience it!

## **Current Tiers**
1. Serpentium, Ranked Over Diamond.
2. (Coming Soon) Titanium, Ranked Under Diamond.

## **Ore Generation**
1. Serpentium: Spawns From -10 To -64.
2. (Coming Soon) Titanium: Spawns From 20 To -5.

Expect an update that adds a new tier almost every week.
